# M1-4a: sync/store/ynab follow-ups (archived scan, first_seen_at, small hardening)

- Milestone: M1
- Branch / worktree: `t/M1-4a`, `../YNAB_AutoCategorizer.wt/M1-4a`
- Depends on: M1-1, M1-2, M1-3 (merged)
- Touches (exclusive while running): `sync/`, `store/` (incl. a new migration), `ynab/`
- Plan refs: architecture.md §1 (package table rows `ynab/`, `store/`, `sync/`), §3.1. Read only these.
- YNAB access: read-only live (the test transport must refuse every non-GET, as in M1-3)
- Deploy: no

## Goal
Close the follow-ups that M1-1, M1-2 and M1-3 left in `ynab/`, `store/` and `sync/`, so that M1-4b can wire `finbot serve`
and `finbot sync --archived` onto a stable API. After this task the archived-plan scan covers every plan and its result
is persisted, `first_seen_at` uses the tick's sync time, and the low-severity review findings are fixed.

## Scope
1. **Archived Discretionary scan, full and persisted.**
   - Find out why the M1-3 live run scanned only 8 of 14 plans, and fix it so a scan covers every plan the token can
     reach (or reports exactly which plans failed and why, with redacted errors).
   - Persist the scan result in the store (new migration `0002_*.sql`): plan id, plan name, whether it has a
     `Discretionary` category, and when it was scanned.
   - Expose one entry point for M1-4b, for example
     `func ScanDiscretionary(ctx, lister PlanLister, client ClientFunc, db *store.DB) ([]ynab.PlanSummary, error)`,
     plus a store read of the persisted list. Document in your Result the exact signatures M1-4b should call.
   - It stays a one-shot: nothing in `sync/` may call it per tick.
2. **`first_seen_at` / `LastImportSeenAt`:** `store.(*Tx).UpsertTransactions` takes the tick's `syncedAt time.Time`
   instead of calling `time.Now()`. `Syncer.SyncPlan` passes the time it uses for `synced_at`. Add a test that the value
   is injected.
3. **Orphans:** when `Result.Orphans > 0`, `SyncPlan` logs one line with the count (no ids). Keep the field.
4. **ctx on `ynab.Client.GetCategories`:** it takes a `context.Context`, like the other calls. Update its callers inside
   your packages. `categorizer/` and `cmd/seed/` also call it; they're deleted in M1-4b, so make the smallest edit that
   keeps `go build ./...` green (for example, pass `context.TODO()`).
5. **Low review findings:**
   - `ynab/`: wrap response bodies in `io.LimitReader`; don't sleep a backoff after `ErrBudgetExhausted`; round the
     wait seconds up (ceil). (M1-1 review)
   - `store/`: make `formatTime` fixed-width (for example `2006-01-02T15:04:05.000000000Z07:00` in UTC) so string
     compares keep time order at sub-second precision. Add a test showing the ordering. (M1-2 review)

## Out of scope
- `main.go`, `cmd/`, `config/`, and deleting the old categorizer path (M1-4b).
- `ynab.Client.UpdateTransactionCategory`: leave it. M1-4b removes it together with `categorizer/`.
- Slack or any event delivery beyond log lines (M3).
- Converting `sync` from `*log.Logger` to `slog`. M1-4b adapts at the call site.
- CLAUDE.md and `docs/plan/*`: list doc changes under "Docs follow-ups" in your Result.

## Acceptance (each must be demonstrably checked)
- [ ] Unit test: a scan over a fake lister and client with N plans visits all N, persists N rows, and a plan whose
      fetch fails is reported (and is not silently dropped).
- [ ] Live, read-only (env-gated like `TestLiveSync`, e.g. `YNAB_LIVE_SYNC=1`): a scan covers every plan the token
      reaches. Report "scanned X of Y, Z with Discretionary" in the Result. The test transport refuses non-GET.
      Before printing any log, grep it for UUIDs, the token and the plan id: all must be 0.
- [ ] Unit test: `first_seen_at` equals the injected `syncedAt`.
- [ ] Unit test: `formatTime` ordering at sub-second precision.
- [ ] Unit tests for the three `ynab/` fixes (LimitReader cap, no sleep after `ErrBudgetExhausted`, ceil).
- [ ] The migration applies cleanly on a fresh DB and on a DB that already has `0001`.
- [ ] `go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...` green.

## Result
- Status: DONE
- What changed:
  - `sync/`: `ScanDiscretionary` replaces `DiscretionaryPlans`. It scans every listed plan, keeps going past a failing plan, and persists all rows. Failures come back as `*ScanError` (plan names plus redacted errors, no ids). Nothing in `sync/` calls it per tick. `SyncPlan` passes its `syncedAt` to `UpsertTransactions` and logs one id-free line when `Orphans > 0`. `PlanAPI.GetCategories` takes ctx. Live tests now share a read-only setup helper (`newLive`), and the new `TestLiveScan` covers every plan.
  - `store/`: new migration `0002_plan_scan.sql` adds the `plan_scan` table (`plan_id`, `name`, `has_discretionary` (NULL on failure), `scan_error`, `scanned_at`), with `DB.ReplacePlanScans` and `DB.PlanScans`. `Tx.UpsertTransactions(planID, rows, syncedAt time.Time)`. `formatTime` is fixed-width UTC (`2006-01-02T15:04:05.000000000Z07:00`).
  - `ynab/`: the governor token is now taken in a library `Limiter` (`governorLimiter`), not the transport. The library treats a limiter error as fatal for the call, so an exhausted budget ends it without another backoff sleep. Writes are marked on ctx (`asWrite`) so they can use the reserve. The transport (now `normalizingTransport`) caps bodies with `io.LimitReader` (128 MiB, the same as the library). Wait seconds are rounded up with `math.Ceil`, and `hourlyLimit` is clamped to at least 1. `GetCategories(ctx)`.
  - `categorizer/`, `cmd/seed/`: minimal `context.TODO()` / signature edits so the build stays green.
- Why the scan covered only 8 of 14: `TestLiveSync` deliberately scanned `others[:min(8, …)]` to fit its 15-GET budget. The old `DiscretionaryPlans` had no cap, but it aborted on the first plan that failed.
- Signatures for M1-4b:
  - `func sync.ScanDiscretionary(ctx context.Context, lister sync.PlanLister, client sync.ClientFunc, db *store.DB) ([]ynab.PlanSummary, error)` returns the plans that have Discretionary, in list order. On partial failure it returns those plans and a `*sync.ScanError{Scanned int; Failed []sync.PlanScanFailure{Name, Err string}}`. If listing fails or ctx ends, it stores nothing.
  - `func (*store.DB) PlanScans(ctx context.Context) ([]store.PlanScan, error)` returns `store.PlanScan{PlanID, Name string; HasDiscretionary bool; ScanError string; ScannedAt time.Time}`, ordered by name. It returns nil if no scan has run.
  - `func (*ynab.Client) GetCategories(ctx context.Context) ([]*ynab.CategoryGroup, error)`
- Acceptance:
  - Scan unit test (11 plans, all visited once, 11 rows persisted, failing plan reported in `ScanError` and in its row, stale row dropped, failed list stores nothing): pass, `go test ./sync -run TestScanDiscretionary`
  - Live, read-only: pass, `YNAB_LIVE_SYNC=1 go test ./sync -run 'TestLiveScan$'`. Scanned 15 of 15, 2 with Discretionary, 0 failed, 15 rows persisted, 16 GETs, 0 non-GET (the transport refused a POST). The log and the test output were grepped before printing: UUIDs 0, token 0, plan id 0. The 15 includes the active plan (14 others).
  - `first_seen_at` equals the injected time: pass, `go test ./sync -run TestSyncPlan_FirstSeenIsTickSyncTime` (it also equals `synced_at`) and `go test ./store -run TestFirstSeenResetsWhenImportIDAppears`.
  - `formatTime` ordering at sub-second precision: pass, `go test ./store -run TestFormatTimeOrdersAsStrings`
  - ynab fixes: pass, `go test ./ynab -run 'TestNormalizingTransport_CapsBody|TestClient_NoBackoffAfterBudgetExhausted|TestGovernor_ExhaustedWaitRoundsUp'`
  - Migration on a fresh DB and on a DB that already has 0001: pass, `go test ./store -run 'TestMigrationsIdempotent|TestMigration0002OnExisting0001DB'`
  - `go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...`: green.
- Deviations from brief:
  - "No sleep after ErrBudgetExhausted": the backoff after a 503 still happens before the retry that finds the budget empty. That retry decision is inside the library, and the library offers no hook before it. The extra backoff after the refusal is gone. The test pins the backoff to 200ms and asserts a single sleep.
  - `DiscretionaryPlans` was removed. `ScanDiscretionary` is the one entry point.
  - Stored timestamps now always carry 9 fractional digits. Existing 0001-era rows in variable-width RFC3339Nano still parse, but they don't string-compare at sub-second precision against new rows. There's no prod DB yet, so I added no rewrite migration.
- Follow-ups for backlog:
  - Optionally drop transaction-id `op` strings when `UpdateTransactionCategory` goes away (M1-1 finding 3; M1-4b).
- Docs follow-ups:
  - architecture.md §2/§3.1: add the `plan_scan` table and note that the archived scan result is persisted and read with `store.PlanScans`.
  - CLAUDE.md (M1-4b rewrite): `ynab` rate budgeting runs as a library Limiter, and write intent travels on ctx.
